blurb: Divers Incorporated offers scuba diving adventures, including a week-long shore diving trip in Bonaire with accommodations, guided dives, and additional services. They also sell scuba diving gear such as BCDs, safety tubes, and dive-related books and maps. Their Bonaire trip includes unlimited shore diving, land tours, and technical diving support options.
